english.title: Notify false information to police in purported compliance with a serious disruption prevention order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), notified to the police, in purported compliance with a serious disruption prevention order made by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF ORDER..), information which you knew to be false, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE INFORMATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 27(1)(c) and (2) of the Public Order Act 2023.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2023 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
